teaser.en: Corky knobs tipped with spines cover its stems, which makes it a fine living fence and a well-known malaria remedy.
teaser.sw: Vinundu vya gamba laini vyenye ncha za miiba hufunika mashina yake, jambo linaloufanya kuwa ua hai mzuri na dawa inayojulikana ya malaria.
teaser.dg: Mihiye inafwinikpwa ni mafundo ga dza chifundiro genye miya ntsani; kpwa hivyo ni mmea mnono wa kuhenda lichigo, na piya ni dawa ya homa inayomanyikana sana.

summary.en: *Chidori* is a spiny, scrambling shrub of the hot coastal bush, its stems studded with corky, spine-tipped knobs. The Digo boil its root bark against malaria and plant it as a living fence.
summary.sw: *Chidori* ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa na kuegemea katika vichaka vya joto vya pwani, chenye mashina yaliyojaa vinundu vya gamba laini vyenye ncha za miiba. Wadigo huchemsha gome la mizizi yake dhidi ya malaria na hukipanda kama ua hai.
summary.dg: *Chidori* ni chitsaka chenye miya chinachoenea na kukpwera dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina kahi ya weru wa pwani wenye dzoho, na mihiye ina mafundo ga dza chifundiro genye miya ntsani. Adigo nkuchemusha gopha ra miziye dza dawa ya homa, na nkuchiphanda dza lichigo.

about.en: *Chidori* is a scrambling shrub that leans and sprawls through the bush. Its bark is covered in corky bosses, each tipped with a sharp spine, so a stem looks knobbly and is painful to grab. The compound leaves carry many small, lopsided leaflets. The berries ripen from red to black.
about.sw: *Chidori* ni kichaka kinachotambaa, kikiegemea na kujitandaza katikati ya vichaka. Gome lake limefunikwa na vinundu vya gamba laini, kila kimoja kikiwa na ncha ya mwiba mkali, kwa hiyo shina huonekana lenye mabonge na huumiza likishikwa. Majani yake ya mchanganyiko yana vijani vingi vidogo visivyo na ulinganifu. Matunda yake huiva kutoka rangi nyekundu hadi nyeusi.
about.dg: *Chidori* ni chitsaka chinachokpwera na kuenea kahi ya vitsaka vyanjina. Gophare rinafwinikpwa ni mafundo ga dza chifundiro, na chila fundo rina muya mkali ntsani, kpwa hivyo muhi unaonekana una mafundo-mafundo na unalumiza uchiugbwira. Makodzage ga kuungana gana makodza madide manji, na chila kodza dide rina uphande mmwenga mkulu kuriko wanjina. Matunda madide ganaivwa: ganakala ga kundu, chisha maru.

where.en: It grows in bushland and thicket in the hot, humid coastal lowlands, and around homesteads where it has been planted as a hedge.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na katika vichaka vizito vya nyanda za chini za pwani zenye joto na unyevu, na kandokando ya makazi ambako kimepandwa kama ua.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye vitsaka na tsakani kpwenye tsi za photsi za pwani zenye dzoho na jeke-jeke, na kuzunguluka midzi phatu ambapho chikaphandwa dza lichigo.

uses.en: The root bark is boiled and taken for malaria by the Digo of Diani. Its spines and tangled growth also make it a useful live fence around homesteads and fields.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la mizizi na kulinywa kwa ajili ya malaria. Miiba yake na ukuaji wake uliosokotana pia hukifanya kuwa ua hai wenye manufaa kuzunguka makazi na mashamba.
uses.dg: Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha gopha ra mizi na kurinwa dza dawa ya homa. Miyaye na vira chinavyomera kpwa kutsanganyikana vinachihenda chikale lichigo ririro na fwaida kuzunguluka midzi na minda.

names.en: The Digo name is *chidori*, and the Mgombato dictionary describes it simply as a thorny shrub (Swahili *mti wenye miba*, 'a tree with thorns'). In Swahili it is *mkidori* or *msamburini*, and in Giriama *mkithunga*. No English common name is widely used; botanists call it *Harrisonia abyssinica*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *chidori*, na kamusi ya Mgombato inakieleza tu kama kichaka chenye miiba (kwa Kiswahili *mti wenye miba*, 'mti wenye miiba'). Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkidori* au *msamburini*, na kwa Kigiriama *mkithunga*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza linalotumika sana; wataalamu wa mimea wanakiita *Harrisonia abyssinica*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *chidori*, na kamusi ya Mgombato inachieleza tu dza chitsaka chenye miya (kpwa Chiswahili *mti wenye miba*, 'muhi wenye miya'). Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkidori* au *msamburini*, na kpwa Chigiryama ni *mkithunga*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana; asayansi a mimea anachiiha *Harrisonia abyssinica*.

reason.en: Horsewood, same citrus family and also used for malaria
reason.sw: *Horsewood*, wa familia ileile ya michungwa na pia hutumika kwa malaria
reason.dg: *Chinyapala* (*horsewood*), jamii mwenga ya mdimu, na piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya homa

reason.en: Knobwood, a thorny relative in the citrus family
reason.sw: Mdungu (*knobwood*), jamaa mwenye miiba katika familia ya michungwa
reason.dg: *Mdungu* (*knobwood*), ndugu mwenye miya wa jamii ya mdimu

reason.en: Orange climber, citrus family, used for malaria
reason.sw: Mtambaa wa familia ya michungwa (*orange climber*), hutumika kwa malaria
reason.dg: *Mtseha* (*orange climber*), jamii ya mdimu, nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya homa

reason.en: Another thorny bush used for fencing
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine chenye miiba kinachotumika kwa kutengeneza ua
reason.dg: Chitsaka chanjina chenye miya chinachohumirwa kuhenda lichigo

mgombato: chidori (vi) thorny shrub; mti wenye miba.
